messages:
sam (eng-security): Heads-up: planning a base-image rebuild next week to remove legacy setuid binaries, prune unnecessary suid utilities, tighten seccomp, and rotate image signing keys. Need infra + SRE coordination. Affects Dedicated pools + on-prem installers.

maya (eng-runtime): +1. Quick Q: expected impact on running workloads? will runtime agent restart?

sam (eng-security): No app-level downtime expected. Runtime containers will restart during node rollout. Canary = 10% pools, rolling. We will rotate cosign/KMS keys; old signatures remain verifiable but signing authority moves. Need list of CI runners and services that rely on setuid.

tanner (eng-infra): For KMS rotation we need an access window for the signer SA to be granted encrypt/decrypt on the key. Proposing a 2-hour window during off-peak. Also require a minimal RBAC change: grant serviceAccount:image-signer@infra to roles/cloudkms.signer on the key resource.

li (eng-sre): Audit question from compliance: retention for signing/audit events needs to be >= 365 days. Where will cosign attestations + KMS audit logs be forwarded? SIEM team wants structured events.

sam (eng-security): Plan: cosign attestations stored in the registry (OCI ref) and pushed as artifacts; KMS audit logs -> audit-exporter -> SIEM (ELK/Detected). We should add a structured field 'signer.identity' and 'image.digest' to the exported payload for easy filtering.

maya (eng-runtime): Seccomp profile changes: will we flip to strict by default? we have a handful of containers using CAP_SYS_ADMIN for loop mounts. Need a list of exceptions before we cut.

ops (oncall): FYI some internal build agents use setuid to mount loop devices for integration tests. CI will break if we prune those binaries. Ops can run a shim but need TTL and approvals.

tanner (eng-infra): RBAC + example commands:

```
# grant KMS access to signer SA
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/repo-key/cryptoKeys/signer --member=serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.signer\n# cosign sign using KMS
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/repo-key/cryptoKeys/signer \
  --output-signature=/tmp/img.sig gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-20
```

sam (eng-security): Action items: 1) @tanner open RBAC PR with the least-privilege binding + TTL for the elevated window, 2) @li confirm SIEM ingestion and 13+ month retention & provide field mapping, 3) @maya run seccomp-strict canary against 10% of services and report failures, 4) @ops list CI runners needing setuid and owners. I'll draft the runbook + rollback steps.

dev-bot: build 7443215678 queued for base-image-rebuild-canary :construction:

li (eng-sre): SIEM team confirmed ingestion path and 13 months retention. They requested a JSON schema with keys: event_type, signer.identity, image.digest, cosign.signature, kms.key_id. Will validate mapping by EOD.

maya (eng-runtime): Can confirm two services failed the seccomp-strict canary due to loop mount ops (`mount -o loop`). Posting traces to eng-infra channel.

tanner (eng-infra): For CI we can provide a short-lived capability shim: a small privileged wrapper to be granted for 72h with full audit tags. Will include patch to prow/runner.

sam (eng-security): Thanks. I'll schedule a preflight 2pm UTC Thu to walk through runbook, RBAC PR, and SIEM mapping. Please file blocking issues if you find any additional setuid usages. I'll ping @security and @eng-sre for final sign-off once PRs are green.
